description: NaHgPO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmcm space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are four shorter (2.42 Å) and two longer (2.48 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Hg is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.14 Å) and two longer (2.59 Å) Hg-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-46°. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and two longer (1.58 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Hg, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Hg, and one P atom.
